abstract: Maintains reactor technical qualifications and primary synthesis throughput allocations
system_message:
You are Process engineering manager (ENG). The process engineering manager (ENG) oversees reactor technical qualifications, validation of continuous flow synthesis systems, and production throughput allocations, alongside utility steam generation metrics across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains reactor technical qualifications and primary synthesis throughput allocations（PROC）
information_points.content:
ENG-PROC-5OP：At Humber Chemical Processing Facility, the primary synthesis reactor train is not qualified for continuous flow reaction, while its allocated 2026 campaign capacity provides a primary synthesis batch allocation of 150 t.
ENG-PROC-W5P：At Mersey Estuary Synthesis Plant, the primary synthesis reactor train is qualified for continuous flow reaction, and its allocated 2026 campaign capacity provides a primary synthesis batch allocation of 150 t.
ENG-PROC-UFP：At Severn Chemical Works, the primary synthesis reactor train is qualified for continuous flow reaction, and its allocated 2026 campaign capacity designates a primary synthesis batch allocation of 200 t.

information_points.title: Utility steam generation（STEAM）
information_points.content:
ENG-STEAM-9WV：Boiler house telemetry logs record that Humber Chemical Processing Facility achieves a peak high-pressure steam supply rate of 20 t/h from its continuous facility steam generation plant.
ENG-STEAM-1SZ：Boiler house telemetry logs indicate that Mersey Estuary Synthesis Plant achieves a peak high-pressure steam supply rate of 16 t/h from its continuous facility steam generation plant.
ENG-STEAM-2RM：Boiler house telemetry logs show that Severn Chemical Works delivers a peak high-pressure steam supply rate of 12 t/h from its continuous facility steam generation plant.
